Outcome metric label is too generic and should identify total/function NG rate with hearing context.
Judgement remains not_judged despite source conclusions for <30% and >30%.
correctionPlan: Remove the measurement-1 outcome and its derived stats.
Add rows 9, 10, 37, and 38 to changed-factor and outcome evidence.
Model over glue <30% and >30% as subResults under one over-glue-level factor.
Rename outcome to function total NG rate and retain input, OK, NG, and rate values.
Set concise judgement: <30% similar/acceptable vs normal; >30% worse than normal.
